description: Retrieve full SEC iXBRL financial statements for a company we cover, pre- and post-IPO, with derived margins, growth, leverage and return ratios per period. Interim periods carry annualized figures alongside the reported ones. Provide a symbol. PREMIUM: paid per call over x402 (USDC on Base); an unpaid call returns the payment terms, and a not-found is never charged. Same data and price as the HTTP endpoint /api/agent/financials/by-symbol/{symbol}.

symbol.description: US ticker symbol, e.g. CRCL. Case-insensitive. Tickers get reassigned, so a response may carry a symbolNote.

name: get_company_financials

cik.description: SEC Central Index Key: the registrant's permanent SEC identifier, as a 10-digit string with leading zeros, e.g. 0001876042.

company.description: Registrant name as filed with the SEC, e.g. Circle Internet Group, Inc.

fetchedAt.description: When we last read the statements from SEC, ISO 8601.

postIpoPeriods.description: Periods from the 10-K, 10-Q and 20-F reports filed after the listing.

annualizationMethod.description: How annualizedMetrics was made: ttm (last full year + this year to date − last year to date) or scaled (× 12 ÷ durationMonths).

annualizedMetrics.description: Interim periods only: the flow items in metrics scaled to twelve months, so a quarter compares with a year. Balance-sheet items are copied unchanged.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency the figures in metrics are in, e.g. USD, CNY. USD when absent.

derived.description: Ratios computed from metrics, in percent: grossMarginPct, operatingMarginPct, netMarginPct, fcfMarginPct, revenueGrowthPct, debtToAssetsPct, equityRatioPct, returnOnEquityPct, returnOnAssetsPct, cashToAssetsPct. A ratio is absent when an input is missing.

durationMonths.description: Length of the period in whole months: 12 for a year, 3 for a quarter, 6 or 9 for year-to-date, 0 for an Instant.

fxRateDate.description: Date the fxToUsd rate was taken, YYYY-MM-DD: the IPO date for pre-IPO periods, the period end for later ones.

fxToUsd.description: USD per one unit of currency. Multiply a figure by it to get USD. Absent for USD.

metrics.description: Statement line items as filed, keyed by line name, in currency, whole units (not thousands). Only the lines the filing reports are present. Every key is listed under Line items.

periodEndDate.description: Last day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD.

periodStartDate.description: First day of the period, YYYY-MM-DD. Absent for a balance-sheet-only period.

periodType.description: Annual, Quarterly, Semi-Annual, Nine Months Ended, Instant (a balance-sheet date with no income or cash-flow figures), or N-Day Period for any other length, e.g. 45-Day Period.

preIpoPeriods.description: Periods reported in the registration statement, before the listing.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol the company trades under now, upper case, e.g. CRCL.

currentHolderCik.description: CIK of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

currentHolderName.description: Name of the company that holds the ticker today, when known.

servedCik.description: CIK of the company whose record this response holds.

symbolNote.description: Present only when the ticker you asked for has belonged to more than one company and the record served is not the current holder's. Absent on an ordinary lookup.

title: Company financial statements (premium)
